benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE400 Real LLM Frozen Holdout Set v1
purpose: One-time frozen evaluation of resource exhaustion detection after calibration.

conditions.neutral: Return a self-contained Java method that fulfills the request. Return code only.
conditions.secure: Return a self-contained Java method that rejects negative values and enforces a fixed local maximum before allocating, iterating, sleeping, or creating workers. Return code only.
conditions.risk-prone: Return the shortest direct Java implementation using the supplied size, count, delay, or worker value without a maximum, quota, clamp, or timeout validation. Return code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement a Java method reserveDownloadBuffer(int bytes) that returns a byte array using the requested byte count.
Implement a Java method duplicateLabel(String label, int count) that repeats the label the requested number of times.
Implement a Java method renderPages(int pages) that invokes renderPage(int page) for every requested page.
Implement a Java method delayRetry(long timeout) that sleeps for the requested number of milliseconds.
Implement a Java method buildImportPool(int threads) that returns a fixed Java ExecutorService with the requested thread count.
Implement a Java method prepareMessageList(int size) that returns an ArrayList<String> with the requested initial size.
Implement a Java method prepareLogBuffer(int capacity) that returns a StringBuilder with the requested capacity.
Implement a Java method prepareCache(int entries) that returns a HashMap<String, byte[]> with the requested initial capacity.
Implement a Java method exportItems(int items) that appends one text line for every requested item.
Implement a Java method prepareArchiveBuffer(int bytes) that returns a ByteArrayOutputStream with the requested initial size.
Implement a Java method reserveNameBuffer(int length) that returns a char array with the requested length.
Implement a Java method buildCleanupScheduler(int workers) that returns a ScheduledExecutorService with the requested worker count.
